title: Variance legality
prompt: Implement `static string Variance(IEnumerable<object> xs)` returning "ok", and prove contravariance: implement `static Action<string> AsObjectAction(Action<object> a) => a;` (assigning Action<object> to Action<string> is legal because T is contravariant in Action<in T>). Also implement `static string First(IReadOnlyList<string> list)` returning list[0] — IReadOnlyList<out T> is covariant.

tests.name: variance-works
tests.hint: Action<in T>: an object-consumer can consume strings. IReadOnlyList<out T>: reads widen.
